sources.title: Material for MkDocs — Built-in offline plugin
sources.version_or_revision: Current official documentation accessed 2026-10-12; not commit-pinned; plugin marked built in since 9.0.0.
sources.locator: How it works and plugin/privacy behavior, lines 183-228; limitations, lines 245-255.
sources.observed_operation: Opened official documentation; checked local file protocol behavior, search index handling, external asset packaging, and stated limitations.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Offline output can be opened from the local file system and search uses a JavaScript index; when offline mode is enabled, the docs require disabling instant loading, analytics, versioning, and comment systems because file-protocol Fetch calls fail.
sources.applicability: Confirms a real offline/versioning conflict for the candidate; does not prove a separate archive package or custom solution works.

sources.title: Material for MkDocs — Setting up site search
sources.version_or_revision: Current official documentation accessed 2026-10-12; not commit-pinned.
sources.locator: Client-side search and plugin configuration, lines 189-202; page exclusion, lines 269-282.
sources.observed_operation: Opened official search documentation; checked client-side/offline statement, plugin default condition, and per-page exclusion.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Search is client-side and can work offline; it is enabled by default but must be re-added when other plugins are configured. Pages can be excluded from its index.
sources.applicability: Supports local search and an archive-index policy option, but not visible version labels or tested ranking.

sources.title: Docusaurus — Versioning
sources.version_or_revision: Docusaurus documentation version 3.10.2; page updated 2026-07-10; accessed 2026-10-12.
sources.locator: Version snapshots and trade-offs, lines 74-84; current/latest distinction, lines 134-156; delete-version procedure, lines 281-304; archive guidance, lines 449-460.
sources.observed_operation: Opened current versioning docs; checked preserved snapshots, complexity warning, labels/routes, removal steps, and archival options.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Versioning creates snapshots, but increases build time and code complexity and versions can be removed. Current and latest are distinct concepts; an immutable archived build is another documented pattern.
sources.applicability: Supports history affordances and owner retention policy; the versioning page does not prove the requested local offline search package.

sources.title: Pandoc — User's Guide
sources.version_or_revision: Living official manual; page dated 2026-09-26 in the investigator record; accessed 2026-10-12.
sources.locator: DOCX track changes, lines 376-381; reader style handling, lines 4752-4780; word processor PDF workflow, lines 4855-4857.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official manual and inspected DOCX style conversion, track-change modes, media extraction, and tagged-PDF workflow.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: DOCX styles not mappable to Pandoc elements are only retained as custom-style markers when the styles extension is enabled. Track-changes accept is default and ignores comments; all wraps insertions, deletions and comments in marked spans. Pandoc does not directly drive Word-processor PDF conversion.
sources.applicability: Supports import preflight and separate PDF review; does not establish output fidelity for this handbook's proposed renderers.

sources.title: W3C — Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
sources.locator: Meaningful Sequence SC 1.3.2, lines 405-412; Keyboard SC 2.1.1, lines 700-708; scope qualification, line 35.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the normative Recommendation and checked sequence, keyboard and scope language.

sources.title: W3C WAI — Images Tutorial
sources.version_or_revision: Official WAI tutorial accessed 2026-10-12; no software version stated.
sources.locator: Images of text and complex images, lines 86-88.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the image alternatives tutorial and checked guidance for text within images and complex diagrams.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Avoid images of text except where appropriate alternatives provide the same words; complex diagrams conveying detailed information need a complete text equivalent.
sources.applicability: Supports authored, reviewed text equivalents for repair diagrams; not a check of any actual diagram.

sources.title: MDN — Storage quotas and eviction criteria
sources.version_or_revision: Living MDN documentation accessed 2026-10-12; browser behavior may change.
sources.locator: Best-effort/persistent distinction and eviction conditions, lines 209-217; persistence request, lines 212-215.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the reference and checked default best-effort behavior, user deletion, eviction, and persistence API conditions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Best-effort is default; data can be evicted under quota/storage pressure or deleted by the user. Persistent storage is a separate request with browser-dependent approval.
sources.applicability: Supports warning and optional user-controlled backup; it does not establish this application's storage durability.

sources.title: H5P — Importing and exporting
sources.version_or_revision: Official H5P author guide, accessed 2026-10-12; no package version stated.
sources.locator: Download and upload conditions, lines 22-47; cross-site reuse, lines 52-58.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official author guide's paginated copy after the canonical page timed out; inspected the same article's download/upload and reuse sections.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: An H5P file cannot be opened locally and must be uploaded to a supporting H5P site. Download is available only when enabled in Display options. Cross-site reuse uses download/upload; copy/paste is limited to one H5P site.
sources.applicability: Supports the host dependency and adds a configuration precondition to the draft's H5P comparison.

sources.applicability: Supports per-type and per-version testing rather than platform-wide accessibility assumptions.
